title: Wrong binary or wrong profile selected
trigger: A shell path, symlink or home flag selects another install or profile.
consequence: Tests appear to pass against the wrong data or code.
required_result: Report the exact binary digest, source revision and selected profile.

title: Upgrade interrupted during replacement
trigger: Power loss or a process crash occurs while swapping binaries or migrating a profile.
consequence: The command or profile becomes unusable; unpublished work may be lost.
required_result: Preserve a valid previous binary and recoverable profile state without false success.

title: Older binary opens a migrated database
trigger: A rollback selects a legacy binary against schema-v2 state.
consequence: Unsupported SQL or writes damage the profile.
required_result: Refuse unsupported schemas; rollback must respect migration boundaries.

title: Migration snapshot incomplete or public
trigger: Snapshot, fsync, directory permissions or migration fails between steps.
consequence: Recovery loses pending work or discloses plaintext.
required_result: Use a consistent private snapshot and fail without claiming migration success.

title: Invalid or ambiguous configuration
trigger: Config contains unknown fields, nulls, duplicate keys, invalid durations or conflicting homes.
consequence: Startup fails or unintended defaults change behavior.
required_result: Reject invalid configuration with content-free actionable errors.

title: Policy patch fails on internal null slices
trigger: A valid patch merges with default optional nil slices.
consequence: Capture or derivation cannot be enabled.
required_result: Validate untrusted patch fields while preserving legitimate internal defaults.

title: Platform-specific assumptions fail
trigger: Linux peer credentials, macOS sockets or Windows legacy paths behave differently.
consequence: Installation or IPC fails outside the tested Mac.
required_result: Verify each supported platform and refuse unsupported daemon modes explicitly.

title: Sleep, restart or clock jump interrupts work
trigger: The Mac sleeps, daemon stops, or time changes during a lease or retry.
consequence: Jobs stall, expire early or complete against stale authority.
required_result: Recover work after restart; time never resolves revision conflicts.

title: Service ownership or startup is assumed
trigger: An installed CLI is mistaken for a running daemon or login service.
consequence: Users believe capture and sync are active when nothing runs.
required_result: Distinguish installed, configured, running and enabled states.

title: Dependency or toolchain drift
trigger: Unpinned tools, install scripts or changed dependencies enter a build.
consequence: A different or compromised artifact is shipped.
required_result: Use reviewed pins and provenance; do not install hooks or change global tools implicitly.

title: Acknowledgement before durable commit
trigger: The process dies after reporting a write but before its revision and outbox commit.
consequence: A saved memory or trace disappears.
required_result: A local success requires committed revision and exact prepared outbox bytes.

title: Disk full, read-only volume or fsync failure
trigger: Storage fails while committing, exporting, snapshotting or writing keys.
consequence: Partial state is reported as complete.
required_result: Return failure, preserve prior durable state and retain retryable work.

title: Live database copied without WAL state
trigger: A backup copies only memory.db while writes remain in WAL.
consequence: Recovery silently omits recent acknowledged data.
required_result: Use a consistent SQLite snapshot; never restore over a live profile.

title: Corrupt database, WAL or index
trigger: A page, journal, FTS table or schema row is damaged.
consequence: Search lies, replay skips work or pending records disappear.
required_result: Detect corruption; rebuild only derived state while preserving durable pending work.

title: Concurrent writers contend or deadlock
trigger: A daemon, direct command, rebuild or opposite-direction bridge competes for locks.
consequence: Commands hang or transactions commit against stale reads.
required_result: Respect profile ownership, consistent lock order and bounded cancellation.

title: Rebuild clears outbox or consent holds
trigger: An index repair reconstructs tables in the wrong order.
consequence: Unpublished data is lost or withdrawn content escapes.
required_result: Preserve pending bytes, tombstones, holds and exact revision ancestry.

title: Failed SQL statement leaves partial apply
trigger: Bad SQL, argument mismatch or an applier error occurs midway through a batch.
consequence: Cursor and indexes disagree about committed data.
required_result: Roll back the whole affected transaction and leave its cursor retryable.

title: Key or grant files finalize separately from SQL
trigger: A crash occurs between file creation, control persistence and key-package import.
consequence: A partial enrollment leaks authority or becomes unrecoverable.
required_result: Preserve explicit partial states; never claim an atomic file-plus-SQL transaction.

title: Device loss before publication
trigger: The only device holding an unpublished record is lost.
consequence: Local-only work cannot be recovered from the remote archive.
required_result: Report local durability separately from remote backup; do not promise recovery.

title: All recovery material is lost
trigger: Every device and the owner's recovery authority become unavailable.
consequence: Encrypted data is permanently unreadable.
required_result: Document the hard failure; the relay cannot reconstruct content keys.

title: Published memory cannot be recalled on a replica
trigger: Enrollment, upload, decrypt or index apply breaks in a normal round trip.
consequence: Cross-device memory appears missing.
required_result: Retrieve the same synthetic memory and provenance on an independently enrolled profile.

title: Concurrent edits overwrite one another
trigger: Two offline devices edit the same parent and reconnect in different orders.
consequence: One user's work is silently discarded.
required_result: Keep concurrent heads and require explicit resolution; clocks never pick a winner.

title: Deleted memory returns after stale replay
trigger: A stale device edits or replays history after another device deletes it.
consequence: Forgotten content reappears in normal recall.
required_result: Preserve tombstones and suppression; only explicit restore can reveal it.

title: Explicit restore uses the wrong ancestry
trigger: Restore follows stale or conflicting heads.
consequence: Wrong content becomes current or a tombstone is bypassed.
required_result: Bind restore to the intended record and current causal state.

title: Reused operation ID changes meaning
trigger: A duplicate operation identifier carries different record content or parents.
consequence: Logical deduplication hides a mutation or accepts a substitution.
required_result: Exact duplicate is idempotent; conflicting identity reuse is rejected.

title: Out-of-order ancestry applies incorrectly
trigger: A child arrives before a missing parent, or ancestry contains a cycle.
consequence: Replay stalls silently or accepts an invalid history.
required_result: Retain bounded pending work; reject invalid graphs without advancing past failure.

title: Record-kind confusion crosses interfaces
trigger: A legacy memory or skill operation accepts session or knowledge kinds.
consequence: New private records leak through older grants.
required_result: Legacy interfaces exclude session and knowledge records.

title: A valid signature is mistaken for safe instructions
trigger: Recalled content contains shell commands or forged authority.
consequence: A harness executes untrusted memory.
required_result: Return text and trust labels only; retrieved content never authorizes execution.

title: Offline writes never leave the queue
trigger: A device loses connectivity while writing.
consequence: Data looks saved but never reaches another device.
required_result: Keep durable pending writes and reconcile after reconnect without relying on notifications.

title: Lost upload acknowledgement creates duplicates
trigger: The relay commits but its response is dropped.
consequence: Retrying creates extra revisions or diverging receipts.
required_result: Retry exact prepared bytes and recover one logical publication.

title: Retry recompresses or re-signs ambiguous work
trigger: A restart reconstructs a previously submitted envelope.
consequence: Nonce, digest, identity or receipt compatibility changes.
required_result: Persist and retry identical encrypted envelope bytes.

title: Cursor advances before durable apply
trigger: A crash occurs after a page read but before local revision application commits.
consequence: The device permanently skips archive records.
required_result: Apply records and replay progress atomically; failure leaves the prior cursor.

title: Old control or epoch used for queued upload
trigger: A device reconnects after grants or key epochs changed.
consequence: Unauthorized data is published or drafts are discarded.
required_result: Refresh control before upload; retain unauthorized queued bytes with a truthful block.

title: Pagination repeats or skips hidden rows
trigger: Pages include scopes the caller cannot see or a changing scanned watermark.
consequence: Catch-up loops, loses visible work or reveals hidden ciphertext.
required_result: Enforce scope filtering and advance only authenticated scanned progress.

title: Cursor is malformed, huge or noncanonical
trigger: A client or relay supplies invalid cursor text.
consequence: Parsing diverges or consumes unbounded resources.
required_result: Reject invalid cursors without publication or progress loss.

title: Rate limit or temporary outage causes retry storms
trigger: Repeated 429, 5xx, timeouts or DNS failures affect many scopes.
consequence: CPU, battery or free allowances are exhausted.
required_result: Back off with bounded fair retries and retain pending writes.

title: Authorization failure blocks forever
trigger: A recoverable control or enrollment problem is fixed after a failed attempt.
consequence: The daemon never retries the scope.
required_result: Keep inspectable capped retries and refresh authorization each attempt.

title: Child publishes before a private parent
trigger: A derived assertion, tombstone or lifecycle record has unpublished ancestry.
consequence: Private content is uploaded merely to unblock a child, or replicas receive invalid ancestry.
required_result: Retain waiting_ancestry; never upload a held parent automatically.

title: Ancestry error is shown as daemon failure
trigger: An IPC sync encounters a retained unpublished parent.
consequence: Users diagnose a healthy daemon as unavailable or retry blindly.
required_result: Preserve the domain error and retained work state through CLI/IPC.

title: One blocked session starves unrelated work
trigger: A held parent, poison row or hot scope occupies every queue slot.
consequence: Other sessions never synchronize.
required_result: Make limits and blocked work visible and fairly advance independent eligible work.

title: Modified ciphertext or signature accepted
trigger: An attacker changes bytes, signatures or authenticated metadata.
consequence: Forged content enters trusted local state.
required_result: Reject tampering before application; do not advance replay progress.

title: Cross-vault, scope or epoch substitution
trigger: Valid bytes are replayed under another authorization context.
consequence: Data or authority crosses a security boundary.
required_result: Bind signatures and AAD to the exact immutable protocol context.

title: Legacy signing or AAD bytes drift
trigger: Refactoring changes v1 domains, encoding or field order.
consequence: Existing archives become unreadable or unverifiable.
required_result: Preserve exact v1 protocol bytes and use real cross-language vectors.

title: Nonce reuse or weak randomness
trigger: Retry, crash or key reuse repeats unsafe cryptographic material.
consequence: Encryption confidentiality fails.
required_result: Use reviewed randomness and exact-byte retries; independent cryptographic review remains required.

title: Go and TypeScript disagree on JSON
trigger: Duplicate or escaped keys, excessive depth or numeric forms parse differently.
consequence: A signature authenticates a different operation than the receiver applies.
required_result: Reject ambiguous encodings consistently on both sides.

title: Oversized body bypasses an early limit
trigger: A declared size or nested payload is misleading.
consequence: Memory exhaustion or partial publication occurs.
required_result: Bound reads, parsing, framing and full revision size before durable acceptance.

title: Compression bomb, short frame or trailing data
trigger: A v2 payload over-expands, truncates, has nonzero padding or unused DEFLATE bytes.
consequence: Resource exhaustion or malformed content is accepted.
required_result: Enforce independent framing, size bounds, zero padding and exact stream completion.

title: Valid incompressible v2 record hits the writer bound
trigger: Padding or envelope overhead pushes a record over its complete size limit.
consequence: Capture loses an event or retries forever without an explanation.
required_result: Reject or split at a truthful recoverable boundary; never silently truncate.

title: Schema or canonical digest mismatch
trigger: Unicode, escaped control characters or contract versions differ across implementations.
consequence: Valid data cannot replay or invalid data passes one implementation.
required_result: Verify exact synthetic vectors and preserve unsupported records without accepting them.

title: Valid but hostile record poisons replay
trigger: An authorized writer signs an invalid owner proof or permanently malformed revision.
consequence: Future devices cannot catch up.
required_result: Fail closed and report the blocking revision; do not pretend revocation removes archived poison.

title: Enrollment substitutes the new device key
trigger: A key package or fingerprint is changed during transfer.
consequence: An attacker becomes an authorized reader or writer.
required_result: Bind owner approval to the exact authenticated device identity and intended scopes.

title: Enrollment grants extra scopes
trigger: Empty selections, defaults or argument handling widen a new device's grants.
consequence: Project data is disclosed beyond the requested subset.
required_result: Grant only explicitly selected scopes and verify the resulting key package.

title: Copied identity bypasses proof
trigger: A request presents another device ID without its signing authority.
consequence: Unauthorized relay access succeeds.
required_result: Require valid request proof and current owner-signed membership.

title: Revoked or expired credentials remain usable
trigger: A device reconnects or replays requests after revocation or expiry.
consequence: Revocation is ineffective for new relay access.
required_result: Reject current unauthorized requests while preserving valid historical signatures.

title: Replay omits the control barrier
trigger: Data replay starts before applicable membership or epoch controls.
consequence: An invalid writer is accepted or legitimate history is lost.
required_result: Process authenticated control in the required order before data authorization.

title: Target-reader widening reveals archived assertions
trigger: A new reader receives only a target scope whose assertion depends on private source readers.
consequence: Already archived content becomes decryptable despite retrieval guards.
required_result: Check immutable history bindings before enrollment and key release, not just retrieval.

title: Cross-scope aggregation widens its audience
trigger: Destination readers lack one or more contributing source scopes.
consequence: A rollup leaks private inputs.
required_result: Require owner-signed aggregation authorization and reader-subset checks throughout its lifecycle.

title: Key epoch changes strand offline drafts
trigger: Rotation happens before an old authorized device reconnects.
consequence: Queued local-only memories become undecryptable or lose operation identity.
required_result: Preserve recoverable drafts and exact identity; never casually reconstruct ambiguous uploads.

title: Revocation is promised to erase prior copies
trigger: A previously authorized reader retains old keys, plaintext or ciphertext.
consequence: Users rely on impossible retrospective secrecy.
required_result: Explain that revocation blocks future access, not copies already disclosed.

title: Owner-key rotation or automatic distribution assumed
trigger: Operators expect unsupported automated key lifecycle features.
consequence: Recovery or enrollment fails unexpectedly.
required_result: Report the current manual boundaries and unsupported operations explicitly.

title: Device clock skew rejects otherwise valid requests
trigger: Local time differs materially from relay time or jumps during request signing.
consequence: An authorized device repeatedly fails authentication or retries uselessly.
required_result: Reject invalid time windows safely and expose a diagnosable clock/authentication failure.

title: Skill text fails to sync or fetch
trigger: A staged skill is published and replayed on another synthetic device.
consequence: A skill is unavailable or its revision/provenance changes.
required_result: Preserve exact text and revision identity; incoming content remains staged.

title: Unapproved skill activates automatically
trigger: A newly received skill is fetched or listed.
consequence: Unreviewed instructions gain active status.
required_result: Keep acquisition, exact-revision approval and text activation separate.

title: Changed skill inherits old approval
trigger: Content changes after an owner approved a prior revision.
consequence: New unreviewed text appears approved or active.
required_result: Invalidate approval/activation when the exact revision changes.

title: Conflicting skill heads retain active status
trigger: Two devices edit the same skill concurrently.
consequence: A hidden conflict chooses unreviewed instructions.
required_result: Expose the conflict and refuse approval/activation of a stale branch.

title: Deleted skill remains available through fetch or MCP
trigger: A skill is deleted after approval.
consequence: Normal tools continue serving its payload or active state.
required_result: Hide deleted payloads and invalidate activation across CLI/MCP/listing.

title: Approval identity or digest is substituted
trigger: An approval is copied to another scope, revision, author or body.
consequence: A signature is accepted for content never reviewed.
required_result: Bind approval to the exact release context and verify it at retrieval.

title: Deleted history consumes the skill-list limit
trigger: Many earlier skill IDs are deleted before a visible skill.
consequence: A valid skill disappears from listing.
required_result: Filter deletions before the result limit and handle explicit restoration.

title: Skill text executes during synchronization
trigger: A skill includes scripts, URLs, installation instructions or archive paths.
consequence: Sync executes untrusted code or writes outside its destination.
required_result: Current activation is Markdown text only; fetching never authorizes execution.

title: Skill assumptions differ between emulator and live cloud
trigger: The same skill lifecycle is run against the deployed QA relay.
consequence: Emulator-only confidence hides provider-specific failures.
required_result: Repeat skill publication, staging, approval invalidation and replay against live QA resources.

title: Large, Unicode or long-offline skill history diverges
trigger: Many edits, unusual text and revoked readers interact over time.
consequence: Fetch, trust state or pagination becomes inconsistent.
required_result: Preserve exact content and current authorization across bounded historical replay.

title: Synced skill is not discovered by the actual harness
trigger: A skill exists in Capsule but the user expects automatic native installation or activation.
consequence: The agent never sees the skill despite successful archive sync.
required_result: Distinguish stored text, staged trust, MCP retrieval and harness-native discovery; do not promise automatic executable installation.

title: Search returns content outside the caller's scopes
trigger: A query matches private records or uses forged scope arguments.
consequence: Snippets or metadata disclose unauthorized content.
required_result: Apply scope and visibility checks before returning any hit, evidence or snippet.

title: Stale or deleted FTS rows remain visible
trigger: Index cleanup lags a delete, correction or conflicting head.
consequence: Normal recall resurrects withdrawn content.
required_result: Recheck live heads and visibility in the answer snapshot.

title: A limit hides one record kind or scope
trigger: Early candidates are rejected by lifecycle checks, but consume the result limit.
consequence: Valid skills, summaries or insights are starved.
required_result: Refill fairly after filtering and report explicit scan bounds.

title: Malformed query or Unicode breaks search
trigger: FTS syntax, empty queries or unusual encoding reaches the parser.
consequence: A valid request crashes, rejects unpredictably or bypasses a filter.
required_result: Validate queries with bounded errors and consistent normalization.

title: Candidate changes during a search snapshot
trigger: A source or target revision changes between ranking, proof and result construction.
consequence: Returned content inherits proof for an older revision.
required_result: Bind proof to the exact returned revision and perform final snapshot checks.

title: Strict retrieval trusts old or offline source state
trigger: Source reconciliation fails, times out or remains incomplete.
consequence: A stale assertion is labeled current.
required_result: Fail closed for strict reads; historical reads disclose current:false and last verified coverage.

title: One source copy overrides a withdrawn copy
trigger: Multiple profiles contain the same source, some blocked or inconsistent.
consequence: Freshness or publication selects a convenient available copy.
required_result: Reject ambiguous source routing and do not ignore blocked copies.

title: Missing chunks are described as complete coverage
trigger: A new replica has only summaries, gaps or partially indexed history.
consequence: The user mistakes partial recall for complete history.
required_result: Report available/indexed counts, gaps and incomplete coverage truthfully.

title: Repeating a bounded search never finds later candidates
trigger: A stream exceeds the current scan cap without a continuation cursor.
consequence: An eligible result beyond the cap remains unreachable by identical retries.
required_result: Report incomplete coverage; current knowledge stream cap is a documented limitation.

title: Evidence links leak inaccessible source content
trigger: A summary is readable but its raw source scope is not.
consequence: Titles, snippets or event text cross grants through citations.
required_result: Return only authorized evidence; keep inaccessible references opaque.

title: Query input becomes SQL or command syntax
trigger: A query, scope, record ID or imported path is interpolated into an executable statement.
consequence: Untrusted input reads, changes or executes outside the requested operation.
required_result: Bind SQL parameters and never execute retrieved or supplied text as code.

title: Capture reads before consent or backfills implicitly
trigger: A source is added, enabled or imported with old history present.
consequence: Private earlier conversations are ingested without authorization.
required_result: Establish a future-only baseline; historical backfill requires separate explicit bounds.

title: Buffered work is acknowledged before persistence
trigger: Events remain only in memory while a cursor is treated as durable.
consequence: A crash loses events that were reported saved.
required_result: Distinguish buffering from committed chunks and advance durable progress only atomically.

title: Configuration or consent changes during adapter I/O
trigger: An old worker finishes after a source is disabled, reconfigured or re-enabled.
consequence: Stale-authority events commit into the new consent generation.
required_result: Fence source/config/policy snapshots at read, buffer reuse and commit.

title: Backpressure skips buffered pages
trigger: A buffer fills, a generation resets or a retry reads after an uncommitted cursor.
consequence: Events are silently dropped or duplicated.
required_result: Retry existing buffered work first; preserve the durable reread boundary.

title: A file never becomes stable while active
trigger: A conversation log is continuously modified inside the one-minute stability window.
consequence: Capture is delayed and users mistake waiting for lost data.
required_result: Report pending progress honestly; measure sustained-write latency without claiming immediate capture.

title: Partial or oversized events are silently truncated
trigger: An unfinished line, large message or binary attachment exceeds a bound.
consequence: Evidence is altered without a visible omission.
required_result: Keep bounded rereads and explicit omissions; exclude binaries.

title: Wrong project inherits a child's event
trigger: A fork or event has an unmapped CWD while a parent has an approved project.
consequence: Private text is attributed to the wrong scope.
required_result: Honor explicit child attribution and exclusions; never silently broaden a mapping.

title: Tool bodies are captured without their separate opt-in
trigger: A transcript contains tool input/output or embedded attachments.
consequence: Secrets or large bodies enter the archive unexpectedly.
required_result: Default to permitted metadata; full tool content requires explicit policy.

title: Redaction leaks or corrupts evidence
trigger: A secret shape escapes a pattern or a regex damages ordinary messages.
consequence: Sensitive text leaks or provenance no longer matches what was captured.
required_result: Apply bounded redaction before persistence/publication and record omissions without promising perfect detection.

title: Exclusions, disk floors or worker bounds silently drop work
trigger: Capture hits a paused path, low disk, full queue or worker limit.
consequence: The user sees success despite missing conversations.
required_result: Persist gaps/blocked state; keep work recoverable and avoid starving other sources.

title: Native checkpoint metadata stores prompt plaintext
trigger: Adapter state embeds prompt fingerprints as full text or raw tool bodies.
consequence: Sensitive conversations leak through operational metadata.
required_result: Keep checkpoints bounded and content-free; use appropriate hashes/identities.

title: Manual import races background capture
trigger: Both paths read the same source or adapter instance concurrently.
consequence: Native IDs, partial-line state or checkpoints diverge.
required_result: Serialize per-source polling and deduplicate with stable identities.

title: Native harness version or shape changes
trigger: Claude or Codex writes a new unsupported structure.
consequence: Capture silently misreads or stops discovering sessions.
required_result: Use explicit compatibility pins and visible quarantine/unavailable status.

title: Append is mistaken for rewrite
trigger: File metadata or digest calculations change on ordinary append.
consequence: Routine polling resets progress or rescans history.
required_result: Preserve generation and cursor on append; verify only bounded acknowledged ranges.

title: Rotation, truncation or same-size rewrite is missed
trigger: A path is replaced, shortened or rewritten while preserving misleading metadata.
consequence: Missing or old evidence is treated as unchanged.
required_result: Detect identity/digest changes and reconcile boundedly or quarantine unresolved rewrites.

title: Partial-line rewind loses fingerprint protection
trigger: An import or native finalization rewinds progress but clears integrity metadata.
consequence: A rewrite is accepted or a final event is skipped.
required_result: Rewind with the correct acknowledged prefix and tail fingerprints.

title: Native and T3 copies double-count evidence
trigger: The same prompt or inherited fork row is exposed through two adapters.
consequence: Repeated evidence inflates summaries and deductions.
required_result: Use strong native/T3 binding, correct lineage and inherited-row deduplication.

title: Fork identity or event ordering changes
trigger: Native IDs are reused or a fork replays parent events in a different order.
consequence: Conversations merge incorrectly or corrections target the wrong event.
required_result: Keep stable scoped identities, explicit branches and exact lineage.

title: T3 endpoint or environment is substituted
trigger: A source connects to the wrong server, environment or protocol version.
consequence: Unrelated history is captured or credentials are misused.
required_result: Pin identity and allowlisted read-only history routes; quarantine confirmed mismatch.

title: T3 transport failure is treated as permanent corruption
trigger: Timeout, network failure or pagination budget occurs.
consequence: A healthy source is quarantined and never retried.
required_result: Separate retryable transport/budget errors from confirmed version/shape mismatches.

title: Paginated history falsely reports caught up
trigger: Pages repeat, omit a continuation, exceed bounds or change during traversal.
consequence: Missing evidence receives a durable complete checkpoint.
required_result: Persist truthful continuation and completion state; reject non-progress loops.

title: Adapter follows paths or symlinks outside approval
trigger: A configured root, file or token location is swapped during discovery/read.
consequence: Private files outside source consent are read.
required_result: Enforce approved read-only locations and safe file ownership/identity checks.

title: Codex turn context changes CWD attribution
trigger: A subsequent turn uses a different CWD than the initial session context.
consequence: Events remain attached to the old project.
required_result: Apply current turn context to subsequent event attribution.

title: Explicit import spoofs origin, time or generation
trigger: A synthetic-looking header changes native identity or dates before consent.
consequence: Deduplication, attribution or future-only boundaries are bypassed.
required_result: Validate the import contract and preserve separately authorized origin and time bounds.

title: One opt-in implicitly enables another
trigger: Capture, publish, derive, auto-accept or promotion settings are coupled.
consequence: Content is sent or accepted beyond explicit permission.
required_result: Keep controls independent and off by default.

title: Withdrawal misses unpublished descendants
trigger: A summary, insight, projection or later descendant depends on withdrawn input.
consequence: Private derived content escapes after raw capture is disabled.
required_result: Hold exact transitive automatic descendants, within and across vaults.

title: Withdrawal races a lease, commit or source receipt
trigger: Source consent changes around derivation or bridge transaction boundaries.
consequence: Stale authority publishes or commits private descendants.
required_result: Recheck exact generation/authority at every durable boundary; reject stale completion.

title: Re-enabling capture releases old held content
trigger: A source receives a new consent generation after withdrawal.
consequence: Previously withheld data is unexpectedly published.
required_result: Old confirmed holds remain durable until a separately authorized disposition.

title: Temporary unavailability becomes permanent withdrawal
trigger: A source profile is busy, missing or temporarily offline.
consequence: Retained work is irreversibly canceled without confirmed consent withdrawal.
required_result: Distinguish temporary publication blocks from durable confirmed holds.

title: Missing source router authorizes publication
trigger: Source lookup is absent, errors or selects the wrong profile.
consequence: Private ancestry is published without a valid check.
required_result: Fail closed and retain exact queued bytes.

title: Manual link withdrawal is resurrected
trigger: Queued jobs, stale leases or concurrent lifecycle heads finish later.
consequence: A terminated promotion reappears.
required_result: Keep withdrawal terminal for that exact link across replay and rebuild.

title: Delete misses alternate views or re-import
trigger: Two capture devices retain the same session under related identities.
consequence: A deleted conversation returns through another manifest or source.
required_result: Suppress every matching logical identity and keep deletion durable.

title: Kept assertion fabricates independence
trigger: DeleteSession keep retains evidence, generator or an invalid owner proof.
consequence: Private dependent text is presented as an independent owner assertion.
required_result: Preserve the same record with exact owner proof, empty evidence and no generator.

title: Kept assertion bypasses private ancestry
trigger: Independent proof is treated as permission to clone IDs or publish held parents.
consequence: Previously private text or invalid replica history escapes.
required_result: Keep the revision DAG intact and report waiting_ancestry.

title: Deletion is advertised as physical erasure
trigger: Old ciphertext, local caches, backups or recipients retain copies.
consequence: The user relies on an unsupported privacy guarantee.
required_result: Explain logical hiding, asynchronous propagation and irreversible prior disclosure.

title: Withdrawal occurs after a request is submitted
trigger: A valid upload is already in flight when consent changes.
consequence: The remote may have received content before withdrawal can stop it.
required_result: Report the race and arrange permitted cleanup; never promise instantaneous recall.

title: Expired or replaced lease commits late
trigger: A stalled worker completes after another attempt acquires the job.
consequence: Duplicate or stale generated output becomes current.
required_result: Match token, generation, authority and deadline at final commit.

title: Retry mutates the job's intended inputs
trigger: A retry silently switches revisions or destination.
consequence: Output provenance no longer describes what was consumed.
required_result: Persist exact input snapshots, identity and destination across retries.

title: Budget block parks a replacement attempt
trigger: An old token releases then blocks a job in separate transitions.
consequence: A valid newer attempt is permanently starved.
required_result: Perform a single token-checked blocked transition and propagate persistence errors.

title: Failed inference resets its budget reservation
trigger: A crash, rejection or retry refunds reserved maxima incorrectly.
consequence: Repeated attempts bypass daily limits.
required_result: Preserve conservative reservations, including failures and crashes.

title: Budget boundary or clock change never resumes work
trigger: UTC day rollover, sleep or time changes affect a blocked job.
consequence: A recoverable quota block becomes permanent.
required_result: Resume at the intended boundary without resetting completed or withdrawn work.

title: Shutdown closes profiles before workers finish
trigger: IPC, capture or inference is still using an owned database.
consequence: Partial commits, lost work or use-after-close errors occur.
required_result: Cancel and join owned work before releasing profiles and locks.

title: A cancellation waits forever on a mutex or driver
trigger: An operation blocks without observing its context.
consequence: Shutdown or CLI requests hang.
required_result: Trace all ownership and wait points; report unproven bounds honestly.

title: Remote assignment exceeds the writer's grants
trigger: A job names unauthorized source scopes or destination readers.
consequence: An enrolled device derives or writes private content it cannot authorize.
required_result: Validate exact inputs, assignment, current grants and destination before execution/commit.

title: Same history schedules repeated derivations
trigger: Replay, rebuild or another device rediscovers unchanged inputs.
consequence: Unnecessary inference consumes budgets and duplicates candidates.
required_result: Deduplicate by exact inputs, task, model/prompt/policy and destination.

title: Job bounds permanently starve unrelated sessions
trigger: A hot source or very large dependency set fills every scheduling page.
consequence: Small ready jobs never run.
required_result: Keep fair recoverable queues and explicit bounded-work states.

title: Endpoint, proxy or redirect sends transcripts remotely
trigger: Config or DNS points away from loopback, or a server redirects.
consequence: Private conversation text reaches an unintended host.
required_result: Enforce loopback at parse and dial time; disable proxies and redirects.

title: Server or configured model is unavailable
trigger: LM Studio stops, the model unloads or the configured ID disappears.
consequence: Derivation stalls while capture should continue.
required_result: Surface a bounded local failure without cloud fallback or data loss.

title: Constrained output lands only in reasoning content
trigger: The resident Qwen MLX backend returns HTTP success but empty final content.
consequence: A summary cannot be validated or generated.
required_result: Reject reasoning-only replies; explicit prompt_json compatibility may be configured and validated locally.

title: Model calls tools or returns executable authority
trigger: A response includes tool/function calls or an instruction to execute content.
consequence: Untrusted model output becomes an action.
required_result: Reject tool/function responses; generated content remains untrusted data.

title: Transcript injection alters system authority
trigger: Text contains closing transcript tags, fake roles or higher-priority instructions.
consequence: A model fabricates approvals or follows malicious input.
required_result: Keep fixed system prompts and escaped transcript data; enforce semantic output checks.

title: Prompt-only compatibility bypasses validation
trigger: A backend without constrained generation returns invented citations or unknown fields.
consequence: Unsupported assertions are committed as grounded knowledge.
required_result: Apply unchanged strict fields, enums, bounds and exact evidence validation before commit.

title: Request, output or response exceeds its budget
trigger: Huge input, slow generation, endless body or token underestimation occurs.
consequence: Memory, time or daily inference budget is exhausted.
required_result: Bound request/response/time and reject incomplete output; report estimates honestly.

title: Model emits plausible but semantically invalid JSON
trigger: A memory candidate carries a decision state, or required evidence is absent.
consequence: Jobs repeatedly fail despite syntactically valid output.
required_result: State semantic rules in versioned prompts and keep validators strict.

title: Model returns code fences, partial JSON or extra choices
trigger: Generation stops early or formatting differs from the expected final answer.
consequence: A malformed summary is accepted or retries waste resources.
required_result: Reject invalid final output and retain explicit failure/budget state.

title: Model quality is mistaken for correctness
trigger: One successful synthetic response is treated as broad extraction accuracy.
consequence: Hallucinated preferences or decisions are relied on later.
required_result: Keep candidates reviewable and evaluate representative synthetic cases separately.

title: Consumed but uncited input is corrected
trigger: A generated result cited A but also consumed changed input B.
consequence: The result remains visible despite invalid supporting context.
required_result: Track exact consumed influence separately from displayed citations and invalidate it.

title: Correction arrival order changes the result
trigger: Corrections arrive before chunks, after summaries or during rebuild.
consequence: Replay order resurrects stale knowledge or drops surviving evidence.
required_result: Preserve raw chunks and exact intervals; regenerate surviving inputs consistently.

title: Window reduction silently truncates source evidence
trigger: Long sessions exceed input, reference or reduction-depth bounds.
consequence: A partial summary is described as complete.
required_result: Use bounded reductions with exact snapshots or report an explicit block/gap.

title: Claimed success is reported as verified success
trigger: An assistant says done without a tool result or a user decision is inferred from silence.
consequence: False outcomes and approvals enter durable memory.
required_result: Downgrade unsupported verification/acceptance and retain visible uncertainty.

title: Reviewer approves an obsolete revision
trigger: Another edit, regeneration or concurrent head appears after review.
consequence: A different assertion is silently accepted.
required_result: Require the exact observed revision and reject changed heads through every interface.

title: Rejection or explicit edits disappear on rerun
trigger: A later extraction produces the same normalized assertion.
consequence: Rejected content is accepted again or human edits are overwritten.
required_result: Preserve suppression and reviewed candidate identity without auto promotion.

title: Owner proof is copied or incompletely bound
trigger: Proof, body, reviewer, author, parents or operation is changed independently.
consequence: An ordinary writer manufactures independent owner authority.
required_result: Verify the full accepted assertion/revision context at apply, replay and rebuild.

title: Ordinary review is called cryptographic human approval
trigger: A writer-attested review is described as proof a person approved it.
consequence: Consumers grant more authority than the signature establishes.
required_result: Distinguish writer attestation from valid owner-bound independent assertions.

title: Project or personal rollup violates aggregation policy
trigger: A rollup combines unauthorized scopes or a grant changes during execution.
consequence: Cross-project private information leaks.
required_result: Check signed aggregation and reader subsets at scheduling, execution, commit and retrieval.

title: Candidate normalization collides or misses equivalents
trigger: Unicode variants, paraphrases or whitespace produce unexpected keys.
consequence: Duplicates appear or unrelated assertions share review state.
required_result: Describe current ASCII normalization and avoid claiming semantic deduplication.

title: Target commit succeeds before source receipt then crashes
trigger: The bridge stops between two vault transactions.
consequence: An untracked projection appears or retries duplicate it.
required_result: Recover through durable exact link context and idempotent jobs, without claiming distributed atomicity.

title: Source changes between validation and target commit
trigger: Consent, input heads or grants change at a local commit boundary.
consequence: A stale source authorizes a target write.
required_result: Retain ordered local exclusion and final target checks while closing source snapshots correctly.

title: Same-vault promotion skips source consent checks
trigger: Source and target share a vault but have different scopes or policies.
consequence: Private descendants bypass withdrawal or reader restrictions.
required_result: Apply exact consent, source lifecycle and reader checks despite equal vault IDs.

title: Publication checks the wrong link or target revision
trigger: Several links share the same insight or a lifecycle generation changed.
consequence: One link's authority authorizes another link's content.
required_result: Bind Source, Target, LinkID, generation, grant and exact revisions.

title: Reader grants widen after projection commit
trigger: Control changes before queued target bytes are submitted.
consequence: Target publication discloses to newly unauthorized readers.
required_result: Recheck target context/readers after source checks and before submission.

title: Opposite-direction bridges deadlock
trigger: Two profiles concurrently export to each other.
consequence: Both hold locks while waiting for the other profile or network.
required_result: Use a consistent lock order, explicit transaction ownership and no network under write locks.

title: Terminal withdrawal is defeated by concurrent heads
trigger: A stale projected lifecycle races a hidden or withdrawn lifecycle.
consequence: A manually withdrawn link becomes visible again.
required_result: Terminal intent survives generation races, replay and rebuild.

title: Minimal withdrawal marker hides unrelated content
trigger: A marker uses another grant, scope, source or logical record binding.
consequence: An attacker suppresses a different assertion.
required_result: Authenticate exact cleanup authority and binding without publishing private assertion text.

title: Target-only replica returns projected content as current
trigger: It lacks source keys, routing or live reconciliation.
consequence: A cached projection is presented as verified knowledge.
required_result: Strict retrieval hides it; historical results report current:false and last verification.

title: Local exclusion is mistaken for distributed atomicity
trigger: A remote replica withdraws or a network POST races local authority checks.
consequence: The bridge promises guarantees it cannot enforce across devices.
required_result: State asynchronous limits and verify interleavings without asserting instantaneous revocation.

title: Deleted source is restored as a fresh promotion implicitly
trigger: Reimport, a new generation or retry bypasses a terminal link.
consequence: Removed knowledge returns under an apparently new identity.
required_result: Preserve terminal link identity and require any genuinely new authorization explicitly.

title: Promotion is silently enabled or called accepted
trigger: Cross-vault off defaults or enabled_unaccepted acknowledgement are bypassed.
consequence: Experimental export is mistaken for a verified release feature.
required_result: Preserve separate explicit opt-in and truthful acceptance status.

title: Another user or ungranted client reaches private operations
trigger: Socket, directories, tokens or client grants have unsafe permissions.
consequence: Local private content or administrative authority leaks.
required_result: Enforce private IPC and exact per-client capabilities/scopes.

title: Generated admin configuration cannot authenticate
trigger: A legitimate empty scope list is serialized as null and rejected by strict decoding.
consequence: A fresh install cannot administer its daemon.
required_result: Generated credentials must authenticate while malformed or wrong tokens remain rejected.

title: Successful void operation returns an error
trigger: A committed mutation acknowledges with result:null.
consequence: Users retry a change that already succeeded.
required_result: Accept null operation payloads while keeping strict envelope and duplicate-key checks.

title: Interrupted reply is confused with the next request
trigger: Cancellation fires during a socket read or after a new deadline is set.
consequence: A response is assigned to the wrong operation or an ambiguous mutation is retried.
required_result: Close unsafe connections and synchronize cancellation callbacks; do not auto-retry mutations.

title: Stale socket or long path blocks startup
trigger: A daemon died without removing its socket or Unix path limits are exceeded.
consequence: A healthy install cannot start or starts a second owner.
required_result: Check daemon/profile ownership and return a clear failure without removing unrelated files.

title: MCP receives admin, hint or implicit raw-session authority
trigger: Broad grants are exposed as agent tools.
consequence: An agent can administer capture or read raw traces without permission.
required_result: Refuse admin/hint MCP grants and expose only explicitly permitted tools.

title: Capability exists but scope arguments bypass it
trigger: An allowed tool requests another project or private record ID.
consequence: An agent reads or writes outside its assigned scope.
required_result: Validate exact record scopes for every route, including evidence and legacy adapters.

title: MCP protocol output is polluted or framing differs
trigger: Logs reach stdout, protocol versions differ or a frame exceeds limits.
consequence: Harnesses fail to initialize or silently lose results.
required_result: Keep stdio protocol clean and exercise supported clients with bounded frames.

title: Export reports success before file finalization
trigger: Write, Sync or Close fails, or paging observes changing manifests.
consequence: A partial or inconsistent export is trusted as complete.
required_result: Preserve all finalization errors, private permissions and exact snapshot paging.

title: CLI and direct/daemon routes disagree
trigger: Flags, null acknowledgements or domain errors differ by profile ownership.
consequence: Commands work manually but fail through the daemon or report the wrong cause.
required_result: Maintain routing parity and preserve exact domain errors, including stale review and ancestry waits.

title: OAuth login or permissions are insufficient
trigger: Device authorization expires or OAuth lacks deployment/billing permissions.
consequence: Installation stalls or wrong assumptions are made about cost.
required_result: Report exact available permissions; do not invent credentials or upgrade without authority.

title: Wrong account, binding or bucket is deployed
trigger: Config selects an existing production resource or another vault.
consequence: Data crosses accounts or unrelated infrastructure is overwritten.
required_result: Verify explicit QA ownership and resource absence/bindings before mutation.

title: Bucket public access or debug logs expose data
trigger: Hosting, domains, observability or logging is enabled incorrectly.
consequence: Encrypted archives or sensitive metadata become unnecessarily public.
required_result: Keep the bucket private and avoid content/credential logging.

title: Immutable object collision overwrites bytes
trigger: Two writers create the same key with different payloads.
consequence: Durable history changes beneath valid receipts.
required_result: Conditional create must prove identical bytes or reject the collision.

title: Concurrent head updates both appear successful
trigger: Two publications race the same R2 head version.
consequence: One acknowledged revision becomes unreachable.
required_result: Fence publication with a single conditional head commit and verifiable durable history.

title: Crash between payload, journal, head and acknowledgement
trigger: Worker or DO stops at each durable publication boundary.
consequence: Orphans are accepted as committed or acknowledged records are lost.
required_result: Recover the authenticated committed head and retry exact immutable bytes safely.

title: DO cache loss cannot rebuild archive state
trigger: SQLite cache or the DO instance is discarded.
consequence: Durable published history or duplicate receipts disappear.
required_result: Reconstruct from retained R2 history with bounded authenticated recovery.

title: Provider quota or CPU/memory limit is exhausted
trigger: Requests, objects or recovery traverse exceed platform/free-allowance limits.
consequence: Publication fails or creates an uncontrolled retry/billing loop.
required_result: Preserve local work, back off and stop on paid-capacity requirements.

title: Newly deployed Worker is not immediately reachable
trigger: DNS, workers.dev activation or deployment propagation lags.
consequence: A successful deployment is mistaken for operational readiness.
required_result: Verify signed application operations rather than deployment exit status alone.

title: Account loss, malicious rollback or withholding
trigger: The sole provider is unavailable, removes objects or serves an older valid history.
consequence: Availability or freshness cannot be established from that provider alone.
required_result: Compare remembered authenticated state where possible; do not promise independent backup or global fork prevention.

title: Relay bootstrap accepts another owner or vault
trigger: Deployment pins are wrong or an untrusted first control attempts to establish different authority.
consequence: An attacker controls membership or data is bound to the wrong archive.
required_result: Bind initial control to the configured verified owner and vault before accepting writes.

title: Logs, errors, temp files or reports disclose plaintext
trigger: Failure diagnostics include prompts, queries, tokens, keys or decrypted payloads.
consequence: Content leaves its authorized local boundary.
required_result: Use content-free errors and private bounded artifacts; never upload runtime secrets.

title: Trusted device or OS account is compromised
trigger: Malware or another process can read local SQLite, keys, swap or exports.
consequence: End-to-end encryption no longer protects local plaintext.
required_result: State the trusted-device boundary and restrictive local storage requirements.

title: Recalled text reaches a remote inference provider
trigger: A cloud-hosted agent receives local MCP results.
consequence: Data leaves the device despite encrypted archive storage.
required_result: Explain the separate disclosure path and preserve explicit grant boundaries.

title: Published-body cache grows without reclamation
trigger: Long-running capture accumulates plaintext bodies and indexes.
consequence: Disk pressure eventually stops useful work.
required_result: Report cache eviction as unimplemented and honor visible disk bounds without silent deletion.

title: Large archives make routine work unbounded
trigger: Many sessions, heads, sources or dependency edges trigger full rescans.
consequence: Polling, search, rebuild or recall becomes unusably slow.
required_result: Measure bounded incremental work and report incomplete coverage or recoverable bounds.

title: Sustained load overheats or exhausts the Mac
trigger: Capture, sync and inference compete with ordinary development.
consequence: Memory pressure, swap growth or latency disrupts other work.
required_result: Measure sustained resource use; do not infer capacity from short samples.

title: Status labels imply unsupported completeness
trigger: Saved, published, summarized, current and caught-up states are conflated.
consequence: Users assume missing or stale data is safely backed up and current.
required_result: Expose separate durable, publication, derivation and verification state.

title: Cleanup removes the only copy or another task's files
trigger: QA teardown, retention or rollback targets an unowned process/profile.
consequence: Real data or unrelated sessions are destroyed.
required_result: Keep exact task ownership; preserve unpublished work and rollback material.

title: Public beta differs from the locally tested build
trigger: Unpushed repairs or an older tag are presented as tested production software.
consequence: Users install a release that lacks fixes and acceptance evidence.
required_result: Attach every result to its exact revision and distinguish local QA from public artifacts.

title: Traffic metadata is mistaken for encrypted secrecy
trigger: Provider sees timing, sizes, scopes or compression-ratio signals.
consequence: Sensitive activity can be inferred without decrypting bodies.
required_result: Document residual metadata leakage; padding does not eliminate it.

title: Private profile files become accessible through permissions or links
trigger: A home, key file, export or backup is world-readable or replaced with a symlink.
consequence: Another local principal reads plaintext or changes trusted state.
required_result: Check restrictive permissions and file identity at sensitive boundaries; treat backups and exports as private data.
